gloss: no drinking allowed; prohibition of alcohol

definitions.gloss: no drinking allowed; prohibition of alcohol
definitions.explanation: A rule, regulation, or instruction prohibiting the consumption of alcoholic beverages. Commonly seen on signs, in workplace rules, and in medical instructions.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}です。
⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}」⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: There's a 'No Drinking' sign posted in the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{医者|いしゃ}→医者：02847_isha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me no alcohol the day before the surgery.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧ (drinking alcohol) and ⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧ (prohibition). This is a four-character compound (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧-style) commonly seen on signs and in written rules. In daily speech, people might simply say ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦だめ→だめ：00693_dame⟧ or ⟦お{酒|さけ}→お酒：01045_osake⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看板|かんばん}→看板：00166_kanban⟧ — no-drinking sign
- {飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧ — no-alcohol area
- {飲酒禁止|いんしゅきんし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規則|きそく}→規則：01382_kisoku⟧ — no-drinking rule

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{禁酒|きんしゅ}→禁酒：15803_kinshu⟧ — abstinence from alcohol (personal choice or medical instruction, not a sign/rule)
- {飲酒運転禁止|いんしゅうんてんきんし} — no drunk driving (more specific)
- {喫煙禁止|きつえんきんし} — no smoking (same pattern with different activity)
